verdict.rationale: Mistral's docs openly describe token-based pricing mechanics without any sales gate: cached prompt tokens cost 10% of the standard input price, batch runs get a 50% discount, and Labs models are free. A public pricing page exists, and a community post cites a public OCR price of $1/1000 pages. However, no evidence quotes actual per-token prices for any model, let alone every current model. Missing for 10: a documented per-model input/output per-token price table, evidence that it covers all current models, and independent corroboration of the published rates.

support.subject: As a founder, I can see public per-token prices for every current model without talking to sales

citations.quote: Cached prompt tokens are billed at 10% of the standard input token price
reducing compute costs while running large workloads at a 50% discount
